name: dpoe_frostbolt
message:
I made a looping ice spear flying right on a 64x64 transparent canvas: 8 frames at 20 fps, no outline, in #8fd6ff with white flicker on the glints. The spear is a built-in ice lance, scaled to 75% so it fits the canvas. Small ice shards spin off behind it and drift up.

Limits: the spear is about 53 px long, so it doesn't fill the whole canvas. The tip is blunt rather than a true needle, and the body is thicker than the "thin" you asked for. I didn't add a dark stone floor because the canvas is transparent. Use the Ice lance colour and Ice lance amount sliders to adjust the tone and strength.
